en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a rustic wooden lookout or rest area in a forest. A simple stairway made from logs leads up a small earthen slope to a fenced platform with a rough wooden table and bench. Tall, thin trees surround the spot. A small sign attached to a tree above the platform reads "Kleister's Ruhe". Handwritten numbers and marks appear at the bottom border of the image, typical of early 20th‑century photographic postcards.
